name: Yugamizora Zena
source:
A cold-type girl who likes tokusatsu.

She awakens in the Labyrinth of Noise Scramble City.
Despite having amnesia, she tries to escape fromthe city in order to save her single mother.
She wears a custom jacket that show her love for tokusatsu.

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
